results.content:

I invoke Paste thousands of times each day and it does not let me down. I switched to it from Pastebot in early 2021 and never looked back. It is a fantastic Mac app with support for logical keyboard shortcut conventions for navigating "Pinboards", selecting multiple items, and modifiers for pasting in plain text. Most importantly it does not capture content from secure applications in the "Ignore" list, as not all provide this security natively like 1Password does. It performs really well even with 4 years of "Forever" history.

I write help centre guides for a software company. Our articles are available in ten different languages, and we use DeepL for some of the localisation work. That means there is a LOT of copying and pasting, which is much smoother with Paste. I've especially found Paste Stack (activate with Shift + Command + C) to be handy for copying text, images, and links from different pages into Intercom (where the articles are stored). Because it's so affordable (and useful), I've recommended Paste to multiple colleagues. My advice has been "It's so cheap, just charge it to your company credit card. It'll save you a decent amount of time and your finance team won't even notice". So far, so good!

results.title: InfrOS: Predict and validate cloud architectures before launch | Product Hunt
results.content:
Deploy → watch things break → optimize reactively. Repeat forever.

We flipped it.

InfrOS takes your requirements upfront — business, technical, compliance — and proactively designs the right architecture before anything gets built. We then emulate it in a real environment to validate performance before a single resource is provisioned. What you deploy is already optimized. Real optimized.

And when your codebase, requirements, cloud provider offering, environment or price changes? InfrOS reoptimizes at the design level. Not a patch. A controlled redesign.

We call it shift-left optimization. We don't predict how your cloud will perform — we prove it.

results.title: Postman: Build APIs together | Product Hunt
results.content:
#### What needs improvement

The desktop app has gotten heavy: slow cold starts, and more features that used to be local now nudge you toward account sign-in / cloud sync. The pre-request and test scripting sandbox also feels clunky next to just writing the check in code. It's still the tool I open first, but it's earned some bloat, and a lighter, more offline-friendly mode would go a long way.

#### vs Alternatives [...] Sonam Bala
Akbar B
Nathan Tran
Akbar B

#### What's great

Postman replaced a graveyard of ad-hoc curl commands and scratch files for me. Turning a merchant's API surface into a saved collection made endpoint probing repeatable and shareable across the team instead of living in one person's terminal history. The feature I lean on daily is environments + variables: defining base\_url / token per environment and replaying the exact same request chain against dev to qa to uat to prod without editing a single request. That's the difference between "does this endpoint work server-side" being a 5-second check vs a rebuild. Collections doubling as living API docs is the quiet second win.
